庭院灯 Garden Lights

太阳能庭院灯（大提琴造型）

Solar Garden Light - Cello Design
中文版

这款大提琴造型太阳能庭院灯，将艺术美学与户外照明融合，是文旅景区、公园步道、小区园林、古街庭院亮化的特色之选。灯体以乐器大提琴为设计原型，线条优雅，兼具照明功能与景观装饰价值。

太阳能版本搭载高效光伏板，白天自动蓄能，夜晚自动亮灯，免布线、省电省心。灯体采用加厚钢材精工焊接，表面户外静电喷塑处理，耐腐蚀、抗紫外线，长期户外使用不易褪色生锈。

灯身还原大提琴弦钮、音孔等经典元素，中式仿古灯笼灯头与乐器造型相得益彰，新中式风格适配多种园林景观。支持尺寸、颜色、光源功率定制。

光源类型 / Light Source太阳能款（可选市电款）/ Solar (AC optional)
材质 / Material加厚钢材 / Thickened steel
表面工艺 / Finish户外静电喷塑 / Electrostatic powder coating
防护等级 / ProtectionIP65
灯头 / Lamp Head暖光仿古灯笼 / Warm antique lantern
适用场景 / Application文旅景区、公园步道、小区园林、古街庭院

English

This cello-shaped solar garden light blends artistic aesthetics with outdoor lighting, ideal for scenic areas, park paths, residential gardens and historic courtyards. Its elegant outline delivers both illumination and decorative value.

The solar version features an efficient photovoltaic panel that charges automatically by day and lights up at night - no wiring, no electricity cost. The body is welded from thickened steel and finished with outdoor electrostatic powder coating, resistant to corrosion and UV, and will not fade or rust in long-term outdoor use.

Details such as tuning pegs and sound holes are faithfully reproduced, paired with a Chinese antique lantern head in neo-Chinese style. Size, color and power are customizable.

公司简介

About Us
中文版

河北盛誉光电科技有限公司旗下品牌「怡彩 YICAI」，专注于户外照明灯具的研发、生产与销售，产品涵盖道路照明、庭院照明、景观亮化、草坪点缀等多个系列，广泛应用于市政道路、住宅小区、公园景区与商业街区。

公司坚持以品质为本，光源、电器与结构件均选用可靠供应商，出厂前经过严格老化测试，让每一盏灯都经得起户外的日晒雨淋。

  • 工厂直供，价格实在
  • 支持按工程需求定制规格
  • 质保完善，售后响应及时
  • 承接市政、园区、小区等照明工程项目
English

YICAI is the brand of Hebei Shengyu Optoelectronic Technology Co., Ltd., specializing in the R&D, manufacturing and sales of outdoor lighting products, including street lights, garden lights, landscape lights and lawn lights. Our products are widely used on municipal roads, in residential communities, parks, scenic areas and commercial districts.

Quality comes first: light sources, electrical components and structural parts are all selected from reliable suppliers, and every lamp passes strict aging tests before delivery to withstand outdoor conditions.

  • Factory-direct supply at competitive prices
  • Custom specifications available for engineering projects
  • Reliable warranty with responsive after-sales service
  • Undertaking municipal, park and community lighting projects
